exposure: salivary vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) levels
cohort: Premature neonates born at less than 34 weeks gestational age with no history of maternal or neonatal infections.
finding: Salivary levels of IL-6, IL-8, VEGF, and TNF-alpha on days 1 and 7 of life were significantly higher in premature neonates with moderate to severe ROP compared to those with none to mild ROP.
